nodes.rationale: Feature-space coverage is not label-space competence, so the filter only decides whether to run the probe. nodes.label: PAL-MoE v2 (budget-conditioned modular CL)
nodes.rationale: Superseded 2026-09-26 by V3_ARCHITECTURE. Reframes the question from 'how not to forget' to 'how much of the stream is explained by existing capacity and when is buying new capacity worth it' under a fixed parameter/byte budget. Novelty is the combination: expansion-safe residual routing + derived soft responsibility + counterfactual allocation + function-space lifecycle under explicit byte budget.

nodes.label: ResidualAdapter (expert = z + A_i(z), zero-init U)

nodes.label: ResidualGateRouter (nested residual sigmoid gates)
nodes.rationale: Removes the shared softmax denominator: under a shared softmax expansion necessarily perturbs history and locking necessarily blocks the new expert (Fact 15). Plain sigmoid with calibrated bias instead of zero-init multiplicative gamma to avoid a w,b gradient saddle; proportional retention among old experts is exact.
